MONARCH STUDIO — Workflow Registry
Google Docs copy · created 2026-10-09 · identical in meaning to the Notion hub, the Linear project + MON-55, and the local MONARCH_STUDIO_REGISTRY.md. If the four copies ever disagree, the Notion Workflows database row is the authority and the others are corrected to it.


What this is
One registry for every Monarch editing / animation workflow (style). One workflow = one WF code (WF-01, WF-02, …), one unique name, one unique resume key, one section on each of the four platforms, and every section links to the same workflow’s sections on the other three platforms. When a workflow name or resume key is given on any platform, open the registry there, find the row, follow its hub link, and continue inside that workflow only.


Registry on the four platforms
Notion — page “MONARCH STUDIO · Workflow Registry (hub)” https://app.notion.com/p/MONARCH-STUDIO-Workflow-Registry-hub-3f4807e1e916813a9000e7e94ac0ac53 (page id 3f4807e1-e916-813a-9000-e7e94ac0ac53) with the inline database “Workflows” (database 8e8f1c1c-30c9-4b15-badd-cff77d64a80b, data source 46fbf9a3-c149-4965-81a5-fe2a48bd3999) and the child page “How to add a workflow — checklist” (3f4807e1-e916-81c2-b5b5-ef1cb8412710).
Linear — project “MONARCH STUDIO · Workflow Registry” (id 0a01b89d-3c9d-4193-8416-76b32d76cfca, team MON) and its index issue MON-55 https://linear.app/monarchmation/issue/MON-55 (attachments: Notion hub, Drive folder, this document). All projects: https://linear.app/monarchmation/team/MON/projects
Google Drive — folder “MONARCH STUDIO” https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-wAt4bgYVn7q15uq22ZnRY8z5iIQaI-l (id 1-wAt4bgYVn7q15uq22ZnRY8z5iIQaI-l) in My Drive root; one sub-folder per workflow; this document lives in it.
Google Docs — this document (id 1ONXXVp-yYG2P9ldUPBOSAhr8oWkS79qgzdu6eGHTm8Q); each workflow also has its own “WF-nn · Name — HUB” document inside its Drive folder.
Local — in the WF-01 sandbox: MONARCH_STUDIO_REGISTRY.md (root), studio/WORKFLOW_TEMPLATE.md, studio/new_workflow.py (scaffolds workflows/<slug>/ and appends the registry row). A copy of the registry .md is kept in the Drive folder.


Resume protocol
1. A workflow name or resume key is mentioned (for example “best video reel editing”).
2. Open the registry on whatever platform is at hand and find the row by WF code, name or key. Never resolve by the bare phrase “Monarch Stickman Animation” — before 2026-10-09 it belonged to two different workflows (see the name-collision note).
3. Follow that row’s hub link on the same platform: Linear project body §0 → resume issue newest comments · Notion hub top callouts → Doc 00 · Drive folder → RESUME_STATE.md · Google Doc HUB → “Current state”.
4. Follow the hub’s own resume order and continue inside that workflow only. Record every change back into that workflow’s sections. A registry row changes only when status, links or open items change.

Name-collision note
Both workflows above were called “Monarch Stickman Animation” before 2026-10-09 (WF-02 in the old chat, WF-01 in this one). On 2026-10-09 the Linear projects and the Notion project page were prefixed with their WF codes so that the names are unique. Always resolve a workflow by WF code + id, never by that phrase alone. WF-01 ids: Linear 4d053022…, Notion 3f3807e1-e916-819e…. WF-02 ids: Linear a813926c…, Notion 3f2807e1-e916-81b2….


How to add a workflow (WF-03, …)
1. Define: WF code, unique name, unique resume key, style/engine one-liner, local root workflows/<slug>/ (never mixed with another workflow’s sources).
2. Google Drive: create folder “WF-nn · Name” inside MONARCH STUDIO. Every deliverable goes there with its md5 recorded.
3. Google Docs: create “WF-nn · Name — HUB”, move it into that folder; sections = identity, resume key, the 4 platform links + registry, resume order, current state, open items, rules.
4. Notion: Projects-DB page “WF-nn · Name” with a top LINKS callout; its Docs in the Docs DB (Doc 00 = current state); then add the row in the Workflows database on the registry hub with all four URLs, key, status, open items, and relate it to the project page.
5. Linear: project “WF-nn · Name” (team MON) — body §0 = current state + LINKS block; issue “00 · RESUME KEY …” with attachments (Notion hub, Drive folder, Google Doc HUB); a STATE comment on that issue after every working turn.
6. Registry rows: Linear registry project body + MON-55 table · this document’s Workflows section · local MONARCH_STUDIO_REGISTRY.md (python3 studio/new_workflow.py scaffolds the local folder and appends the row).
7. Local scaffold: workflows/<slug>/RESUME_STATE.md, HUB.md, CHECKLIST.md from studio/WORKFLOW_TEMPLATE.md; upload RESUME_STATE.md to the Drive folder at the end of every working turn.
8. Round-trip test: from each of the four platforms the workflow’s section must link to the other three, and the registry row must reach the hub. Report all ids/URLs in the reply.


Conventions
Naming “WF-nn · Name” identical on every platform. WF codes are never reused. Status values: Active · Parked · Legacy · Planned. Per turn inside a workflow: deliverables → that workflow’s Drive folder (md5 verified, same turn); state → local RESUME_STATE.md (newest block on top) + Linear resume-issue STATE comment + Notion Doc 00 top callout + Google Doc HUB “Current state”; status change → registry row on all four platforms. Never write one workflow’s facts into another workflow’s sections; when a name is ambiguous, stop and resolve by WF code + id first.

Not a still-image slideshow and not a claim of newly modeled 3D geometry.
